items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: And he would take it from there, and Slam would take his part. ... Like Cats and the Fiddle? Yeah, yeah. Well we had to, we had a four voice thing goin' there, we had to. But I mean the three of us we just played

ctx.x: guitar and keep up with him is no picnic.
Did Tatum know that you didn't read music?

Oh yeah. He didn't read music. Nobody read no music. We had no time for no music. I don't know if Slam could read or not, even. Maybe, I really don't know. I know I didn't. Shit, never crossed my mind to read no music. I have faked it quite a few times. I mean faked it too, I faked it in Germany about 5 years ago or 6 years ago --- This one was with Sonny Payne, we were in Frankfurt not Frankfurt -- right next to Frankfurt... Anyhow it was over there with a 70 piece symphony band with Odetta as star. And 5 bass…

items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Along with myself, Tiny Grimes was on guitar. And we had quite a few rehearsals, every chance we got.

ctx.x: Now, did you -- did he like to work out the kinds of progressions that you all were to play or did he just -- did you all rehearse much or did he just --
Yes, we rehearsed quite a bit. Along with myself, Tiny Grimes was on guitar. And we had quite a few rehearsals, every chance we got.
You rehearsed a lot. What kinds of things did you work out in rehearsals, do you remember?
